chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch. 443: The Great Might Nether King's Sacrifice
chapter_meta_description: The Great Might Nether King Ruixiao resurrects after five thousand years, demanding six kings as living fuel for his ascension. A century of agony begins.
og_title: World of Immortality Ch. 443 – The Great Might Nether King Rules
og_description: Ruixiao, a near-ancestor king, captures six kings for a century-long soul sacrifice. Despair deepens as a mysterious figure watches from the shadows.
twitter_description: Ruixiao demands six kings as sacrifice to break into ancestor realm. The six are slowly consumed over decades. Hope fades, but a shadowy watcher appears.
